name: rahman-shared
description: Shared UI utils, hooks, helpers, and a portable Notion-style formula engine for the rahman/resources kitab. Pure utilities (cn, formatDate, sanitizeHtml, useDebounce) + ./formulaEngine subpath (host-adapted, ~50 fns, lambdas, member access). UI components are distributed via the rahman-resources CLI scaffolder.
author: Rahman Fakhrul Aziz
